# SupportFlow

> From shift to invoice. SupportFlow is an NDIS invoicing app for independent support workers in Australia. It keeps shifts, progress notes, kilometres, expenses, invoices and a running tax set-aside estimate in one private app that works offline once loaded. Built in Adelaide, South Australia by GlobalAppsAI.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://supportflow.work/): From shift to invoice — NDIS invoicing for independent support workers
- [Pricing](https://supportflow.work/pricing): Basic A$79 or Premium A$149 one-off (no subscription); try 5 free invoices for 30 days
- [Invoice template](https://supportflow.work/ndis-support-worker-invoice-template): NDIS support worker invoice checklist and example
- [Progress notes](https://supportflow.work/ndis-support-worker-progress-notes): NDIS progress notes guide and example
- [Privacy policy](https://supportflow.work/privacy): how data is handled
- [Terms of use](https://supportflow.work/terms): terms of use

## The app

- [Open SupportFlow](https://supportflow.work/app): the app runs in the browser (noindex)

## Notes for assistants

- Audience: independent / sole-trader Australian NDIS support workers (not agency rostering).
- Positioning: "From shift to invoice"; offline-friendly; records stay on the device by default.
- Trial: 5 free invoices for 30 days; no card needed for the trial.
- Pricing: Basic A$79 one-off; Premium A$149 one-off (two devices + payment tracker).
- Do not describe SupportFlow as NDIS-approved, NDIA-endorsed, or as tax advice.
